title: Forbidden Legend
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji's fingers touched the traces of those two erased names, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly shook violently—as if something that had slumbered for ten thousand years was awakening.

text.content: Outside the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate, black clouds pressed down upon the city. The alarm bells rang continuously like a torrential rain, causing roof tiles to rattle. Each toll struck the hearts of every disciple present. On the distant horizon, dense shadows slowly approached, demonic energy surged like a tide, dyeing half the sky an eerie violet-black.

Chen Ji stood atop the high wall of the Servants' Quarters, his robes flapping violently in the fierce wind. He squinted at the approaching dark tide, yet showed no trace of panic. The alarm bells were ear-piercing, cultivators were panicking, but he watched as if observing a show, even sporting a faint, lingering smile at the corners of his mouth.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji!" A cold voice rang out from behind. Su Qingyao arrived through the air, her robes billowing as she descended beside him, her brow creased with uncommon urgency. "The demonic army presses at our gates—why do you stand here in a daze? Follow me to the sect hall immediately!"

text.content: Chen Ji turned around unhurriedly, his gaze lingering on Su Qingyao's face before he drawled, "Senior Su, why such tension? When the heavens fall, the tall ones will catch it. What can a servant disciple like me possibly do in the grand hall?" His words were nonchalant, as if the overwhelming demonic tide beyond the walls were merely a gentle breeze.

dialogue.content: "You..." Su Qingyao's teeth clenched at his demeanor, but she had no time for arguments. "The demonic commander himself has arrived—this is no friendly visit. This assault is far from ordinary plunder." She paused, lowering her voice. "I discovered a fragmentary record in the sect's secret archives. It concerns... it concerns you."

text.content: A flicker of emotion crossed Chen Ji's eyes at last. He looked at Su Qingyao and took the yellowed silk scroll from her hands. The scroll was battered, its edges scorched and moth-eaten, yet the central text remained legible—ancient seal script from ten thousand years past, documenting a deliberately erased secret.

The script on the scroll was bold and powerful, and despite its faded state, exuded an air of looking down upon all under heaven. Chen Ji read character by character, his pupils gradually narrowing: "In the year one hundred and twenty-seven of the Heavenly Fate Calendar, Chen Xuan attained enlightenment in the Valley of Heavenly Secrets, seeking to break the heavenly chess game. Through supreme divine power, he divided his destiny seed into two parts..."

dialogue.content: "Continue reading." Su Qingyao's voice tightened. Chen Ji's gaze moved downward, and he saw the latter half that shook him to his core: "The divided sons—one shall inherit Heavenly Fate, wield the Tianji Record, peer into heavenly secrets; the other shall enter the Demonic Path, bear the abandonment of Heavenly Dao, and stir the winds and clouds of the world. The two complement and oppose each other. Only when the time is ripe and both sons reunite as one can [the seal]—" A deep crack severed the remaining text, beyond all recognition.

text.content: Chen Ji's fingers gripping the scroll whitened. After a long silence, he spoke in a hoarse voice: "Chen Xuan... was my ancestor." He raised his head, his gaze piercing Su Qingyao like a blade. "Where did you obtain this record?" His tone was calm, yet hidden currents churned beneath.

dialogue.content: "Your mother left it." Su Qingyao met his gaze without flinching. "Before she disappeared, she entrusted this to the sect master's keeping, with the dying words that if her child ever came to the Tianqing Sect, it should be given to him. I've been investigating you for some time, and only now can I confirm..." She took a deep breath. "You are indeed a descendant of Chen Xuan."

text.content: Suddenly, an earth-shaking war drum sounded from beyond the walls, shaking the high wall beneath their feet. Then, a deep, magnetic voice traversed a hundred li through the air, clearly reaching everyone's ears: "People of the Tianqing Sect, hear me. I have come for one person. Hand over Chen Ji within three breaths, or else... Tianqing shall be bathed in blood."

Chen Ji's eyes turned sharply cold. The demonic commander personally seeking him—this was no coincidence. He looked down at the scroll in his hands, recalling the passage he had just read, and already had his answer. The overbearing demonic commander beyond the walls was likely the other half of his fate's twin.

choice.prompt: The demonic commander has arrived—how will Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Since the enemy targets him, Chen Ji chooses to stand out openly, displaying courage while also seizing the opportunity to confirm the other's identity.
choices.visible_cost: May expose identity and draw greater danger
choices.visible_reward: Establish prestige within the sect and intimidate the Demonic Path
choices.risk_hint: The demonic commander's strength is unfathomable; direct confrontation carries immense risk
choices.process_label: 陈机踏空而起，直面魔道大军

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, then thrust off the ground with猛然 force, his身形 shooting upward like lightning. In the blink of an eye, he stood atop the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate, facing the overwhelming demonic tide. "The one you seek is me." His voice was not loud, yet it clearly reached every corner. Instantly, hundreds of thousands of gazes fell upon that solitary figure.

choices.text: Endure in concealment and observe secretly
choices.description: Chen Ji decides to hold his position, letting the sect probe the enemy's strength first while he observes from the shadows, seeking weaknesses and truth.
choices.visible_cost: May be perceived as cowardly, reputation damaged
choices.visible_reward: Maintain mystery and gain more intelligence
choices.risk_hint: If the Demonic Path commander discovers the ambush, the situation will become even more passive.

text.content: Chen Ji's figure flickered, disappearing into the chaotic crowd. He quietly took out the Tianji Record Fragment, and an arcane aura flowed from his fingertips. "Tianji Record, activate..." he murmured in his heart, as golden light faintly glimmered between his brows, attempting to peer into the fate behind this tumultuous situation.

choices.text: Get to the root of the matter, interrogate the truth.
choices.description: Chen Ji decided to first interrogate Su Qingyao about all the truth regarding his mother and this record, to clarify the full context before taking action.
choices.visible_cost: Might miss the optimal timing for action.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain critical intelligence, sort out thoughts.
choices.risk_hint: Time is pressing, intelligence may be incomplete.
choices.process_label: 陈机拉住苏青瑶，要求她说出一切

text.content: "Wait." Chen Ji firmly grabbed Su Qingyao's wrist, his gaze burning intensely, "What my mother left behind... it's not just these things, right?" Su Qingyao's body trembled slightly, a complex light flickering in her eyes, and finally she nodded: "Follow me." She turned and fled toward the direction of the secret chamber, with Chen Ji following closely behind.

choices.memory_label: 陈机追问母亲遗留真相

text.content: Su Qingyao led Chen Ji through winding paths, arriving at an abandoned courtyard deep within the Servants' Quarters. Here, weeds grew wildly, clearly no one had tended to it for years, but Su Qingyao skillfully pushed aside a blue stone, revealing a hidden door. "This was your mother's cultivation place," she whispered, "after she disappeared, this place was sealed off, not even the sect master was allowed to enter."

Inside the secret chamber, a dusty, sealed atmosphere rushed toward them. The walls were covered with dense符文, and on the stone platform in the center lay an ancient journal, the cover bearing the faintly visible words "For Chen Ji". Chen Ji reached out to touch that familiar handwriting, and an indescribable sorrow welled up in his heart.

dialogue.content: "Mother..." Chen Ji murmured softly, opening the journal. On the title page was only one sentence: "Ji'er, if you can read these, it means the Heavenly Chess Game has reached its final board. Remember, the fate of twins is not life or death, but—" The words following were soaked by tears and had become illegible.

text.content: Chen Ji flipped to the last few pages of the journal, where a yellowed list was tucked. The neat handwriting recorded the various arrangements made by Chen Xuan after splitting the Fate Seed ten thousand years ago. However, when his gaze fell on the end of the list, his entire body felt struck by thunder—two names were赫然刮去, leaving only two deep marks.

"These two scratched marks..." Chen Ji's voice trembled slightly. He brought the list closer to his eyes, trying to make out those two erased names. However, no matter how carefully he looked, he could only see a blank—as if some force was preventing anyone from seeing the true appearance of these two names.

choice.prompt: Who are those two erased names on the list?

text.content: Chen Ji forcefully urged the Tianji Record, and an unprecedented arcane power exploded from his brow center. His vision was instantly engulfed by golden light, as two blurry figures appeared in the golden light—one was himself, and the other... the other gradually merged with the Demonic Path commander's figure!

choices.description: Mo Xiansheng has guarded the Tianji Record for many years, perhaps knowing this erased history. Chen Ji chooses to ask him about the truth.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain critical clues, avoid Tianji Record backlash.
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng only says what should be said each time.

text.content: The ink characters on the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly writhed, and an ancient, ethereal voice emerged from the depths of the pages: "Twin-born children, one body with two faces. The answer you seek... lies not in the past, but before your eyes." When the words fell silent, the characters on the fragment remained motionless once more.

choices.text: Ask Su Qingyao to review together
choices.description: Su Qingyao is the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, with extensive knowledge; perhaps she can interpret this list from a different perspective.
choices.visible_cost: Reveal more secrets to Su Qingyao
choices.visible_reward: Solve the mystery together with Su Qingyao, deepening trust
choices.risk_hint: May drag her into a deeper whirlpool
choices.process_label: 陈机将名单递给苏青瑶，请她一同参详

text.content: Su Qingyao took the list, her slender fingers gently tracing the two scratches. Her brow gradually furrowed: "These scratches... were made within the past year. And the person who made them had powerful, vigorous brushwork—they were no ordinary individual." She raised her head, her gaze complex as she looked at Chen Ji, "Could it have been your mother herself?"

"My mother herself?" Chen Ji repeated the words, a sudden flash of insight striking his mind. He abruptly flipped open the first few pages of the journal, carefully comparing the handwriting—the handwriting in the first half of the journal was entirely different from that on the list, but by the middle section, the brushwork suddenly changed, becoming sharp and hurried.

"So that's it..." Chen Ji murmured, a look of understanding flickering in his eyes, "The two names on the list were erased by my mother before her death. She didn't want me to know who that other name belonged to—in other words, she didn't want the Heavenly Eye to find that person through this list."

dialogue.content: "The Heavenly Eye?" Su Qingyao's voice rose sharply, "Are you saying... the arrangement from ten thousand years ago is still under Heaven's surveillance?" Her face turned pale, "Could the Demon Path Commander leading his army here be because of that as well?"

text.content: Chen Ji remained silent. He raised his head, gazing toward the outside of the hidden chamber. Through layers of earth and stone, he seemed able to see that figure standing proudly above the tide of demons beyond the city. That figure was so similar yet so different from him—like a reflection in a mirror, like two sides of yin and yang.

Just then, hurried footsteps suddenly echoed from outside the hidden chamber. A Tianqing Sect disciple rushed breathlessly to the door, shouting loudly: "Senior Sister Su! Junior Brother Chen! The Sect Master has ordered that the Demon Path Commander specifically requests to see Junior Brother Chen. If he doesn't appear immediately, the commander will personally storm the sect gate!"

Chen Ji tucked the journal and list into his chest, slowly rising to his feet. His movements were unhurried, as if what he was about to face was not a life-or-death confrontation, but a chess game whose outcome had been determined long ago. His gaze was deep as an abyss, yet the corner of his lips curved into a meaningful smile.

text.content: "Let's go." Chen Ji said calmly, stepping out of the hidden chamber. The sunlight was blinding; he narrowed his eyes slightly, gazing toward the churning demonic energy at the sect gate. "Since he wants to see me, I'll go meet him—let's see what manner of being this other half of the twin-born of fate truly is."

text.content: "Senior Su," Chen Ji suddenly stopped in his tracks, "if I guess correctly, the sect's great formation should have another hidden gate, right?" Su Qingyao was slightly taken aback, then nodded. A cold smile curled at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth. "Good. Relay my orders—activate the Beast Trap Formation. I want this Demonic Path commander to have no way out."

choices.text: Secretly transmitting voice, testing for cooperation
choices.description: Chen Ji decided to stay hidden for the moment, first using secret voice transmission to test the Demonic Path commander's true intentions, seeking possibilities for cooperation.
choices.visible_reward: Probing the opponent's hidden cards, seeking a way to break the situation
choices.risk_hint: If the opponent is an enemy, the first-mover advantage will be lost
choices.process_label: 陈机以天机录气息为媒介，向魔道主帅传音

text.content: Chen Ji secretly activated the Tianji Record, and a strand of profound aura pierced through the heavy demonic qi, directly entering the ears of that lofty figure: "We share the same roots—why must we wage war? How about a meeting outside the city?" A moment later, a low laugh rang in his mind: "Interesting... you are more daring than I imagined."

Outside the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate, the demonic tide surged like a sea. Hundreds of thousands of Demonic Path cultivators hovered in mid-air, a black mass blocking out the sky and sun. At the very front of the demonic tide stood a tall figure, hands clasped behind his back. His features were seventy percent similar to Chen Ji's, yet more fierce and sinister, demonic qi swirling around him as if he were a god-demon emerging from the abyss.

"Chen Ji, this one has been waiting for you long enough." The Demonic Path commander's voice was low and magnetic, echoing through heaven and earth. His gaze pierced through all obstacles, fixing directly on Chen Ji, a playful smile curling at his lips, "Or should I say—my other half?"

Chen Ji stood atop the Mountain Gate, facing that scrutinizing gaze, his expression calm as still water. He slowly spoke, his voice not loud but clearly reaching everyone's ears: "Ten thousand years ago, Chen Xuan split the seed of destiny in two—one inheriting Heavenly Fate, the other entering the Demonic Path. I am curious—in the end, are we meant to nourish or destroy each other?"

The moment Chen Ji's words fell, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly vibrated violently. An immensely profound power surged from the pages, sketching two vague silhouettes in the void—precisely Chen Ji and the Demonic Path commander.

The instant the Tianji Record appeared, Chen Ji's eyes blazed as he stared intently at the list suspended in mid-air. He saw those two names deeply erased—though the characters had been deliberately scraped away, under the Tianji Record's mystical light, two faint traces remained faintly visible.

He saw it clearly. The first erased name was his original name—Chen Ji. And the second erased name slowly materialized in the mystical light: Chen Nian. "Chen Nian..." Chen Ji murmured, his pupils contracting sharply—she was his only remaining blood relative in this world, his missing sister!

Chen Ji's mind was struck like by thunder. The seed of destiny Chen Xuan split ten thousand years ago—one half was him, and the other half was actually his sister Chen Nian, whom he had believed long fallen into the Holy Sect's hands? This truth was too terrifying, terrifying enough that for a moment he could not untangle its threads. The Demonic Path commander outside the city seemed to sense something, tilting his head back to release a mournful yet mad roar of laughter.

That laughter echoed between heaven and earth, carrying an indescribable bleakness and madness. "See?" The Demonic Path commander's voice cut through the waves of laughter, word by word: "Ten thousand years—I've waited for this moment, waited a full ten thousand years! Chen Ji—no, now I should call you Chen Nian—did you think you were the only one who inherited Chen Xuan's legacy?" He abruptly raised his hand, pointing to his own heart, "I am the true other half!"

The fingers Chen Ji used to grip the Tianji Record Fragment turned slightly pale. He took a deep breath, suppressing the surging emotions in his heart. The layout from ten thousand years ago, the name his mother erased on her deathbed, the truth of his sister's disappearance, the Demonic Path commander entangled with his fate—all of it, at this moment, finally connected into a complete line.
